criteria.text: Creating a payment sends an Idempotency-Key derived from the order, so a repeated attempt never creates a second payment.
Retries happen only on timeouts, 429 (honouring Retry-After) and 5xx, with capped backoff and the owner's attempt limit.
Webhooks are accepted only with a valid HMAC-SHA256 signature over the raw body.
Duplicate and out-of-order webhooks never move an order backwards or apply twice.
When a provider is unavailable the order stays in a waiting state with a visible reason and resumes when the provider returns; it is never shipped unpaid.
A 400 or 422 reply is never retried; the order shows the failure.
No secret (API key, webhook secret, card data) appears in logs, errors or stored order history.

owner_answers.answer: Each call times out after 30 seconds; give up after 5 attempts and leave the order waiting for a person.
Euros only in this version; refuse any other currency.
